newsitem.title: USA: ECC sees Q3 operating losses in vending unit.
newsitem.headline: ECC sees Q3 operating losses in vending unit.

text.p: ECC International Corp Friday said it expects that its vending unit will incur operating losses in the third quarter of fiscal 1997, but revenue is expected to increase in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997.
The company said net losses for its vending subsidiary, ECC Vending Corp, for the six-month period ended December 31, 1996 were $1.3 million.
The company stated it is in the completion phase of several major contracts and expects revenue for its domestic training and simulation operations to decline in the second half of fiscal 1997.
